unequalNotice: Teams are uneven, so the turn order will be random.
loadError: Could not load the themes. Check your connection.
handoffHint: Pass the phone to {name}. No peeking, everyone else!
roundFound: No cards found | 1 card found | {n} cards found
pausedHint: The timer is stopped. Quitting ends the current game.
rulesSubtitle: One phone, a few friends, zero words.
ruleGoal: The first team to reach {score} points wins.
ruleRound: Each round lasts {seconds} seconds. Every card guessed earns your team one point.
ruleMime: The mime keeps the phone hidden and acts out the card for their team.
ruleSilence: No talking, singing, writing, or pointing at things.
rulePass: Tap Skip to get a new card. No penalty.
builtWith: Open source, built with Capacitor and shipped with Capgo live updates.
onb1Body: The charades game for friends and family. One phone, zero words, lots of laughs.
onb2Body: At least 2 teams of 2 players. Add your friends' names, then pick a theme.
onb3Body: Pass the phone to the mime. They read the card in secret and act it out for their team. No talking!
onb4Body: Tap “{found}” for every card guessed, “{pass}” if you're stuck. First team to {score} points wins.
